title: Hoshino Ichika — New Beginnings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can't wait for classes to start!
I'm all read up on everything we're about to learn♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wish I could be as excited about classes as you are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Ichi, are you not looking forward to them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... I am looking forward to some subjects...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I think I'm more worried than excited since other subjects like math will probably be harder than last year.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
Having to learn harder formulas and stuff does make me kinda shudder.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But there's nothing wrong with not immediately understanding new stuff. We can always ask the teachers or Hona for help if we have any questions!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's true.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki always shows so much strength whenever we start something new.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (My mind can't help but jump towards things going wrong... But Saki wants to take on new challenges.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We'll probably be faced with more than a few after we make our debut as professional musicians.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to be able to think like Saki when that happens.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here!
Let's do our best today, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Wait, huh...?
We're in different classes this year. Why are we in front of the same one...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Wait, Saki!
This is 1-C!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
N-No, you're right...!
I was about to walk into a first-year classroom again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Argh! We're second-years now!
We need to start acting more like it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
S-Saki, wait.
I know how you feel, but you're going to startle everyone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Or are we too late...?)

rows.Speaker: First-Year A
rows.Line: Hey, aren't they second-years?

rows.Speaker: First-Year B
rows.Line: They came to the wrong classroom by accident. That's so cute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Oh, they don't seem to mind...
I guess we're in the clear...?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, we need to hurry over to our actual classrooms or we're going to be late.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: R-Right!
Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: ...and we had to get over here in a hurry.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That explains why you were a little late.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can see how you two ended up at the wrong classroom. I mean, until not too long ago, that's what was normal to us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What was normal...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, Emu and I greeted each other just now, but going to different classrooms felt a little odd...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know what you mean. I feel the same way whenever I see my old classmates walking towards different classrooms.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess we're all still trying to get used to our new class.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope we get settled in soon.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too. I haven't really talked to some of our classmates before, so it'd be nice to become friends with them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (In time, the three of us talking like this might start feeling completely normal.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I don't know what this upcoming year has in store for us, but I hope I'll be able to make a lot of good memories.)
